company: Gallop Stable is a public horse-riding centre in Singapore. It has welcomed riders and families since 2003 and focuses on accessible horse experiences and giving rescued racehorses a second chance. Website: https://www.gallop.sg
lessons: Gallop Stable offers Private Full, Semi-Private and Group riding lessons for beginner, novice, intermediate and advanced riders, plus shorter junior pony lessons for young children. Suitability depends on the rider's age, height, weight and experience. Standard riding lessons have a 75 kg limit; junior pony lessons have a 40 kg limit. Long pants and covered shoes are recommended. Lessons require at least 2 to 3 days' advance booking through WhatsApp at +65 8383 6425 or email at enquiry@gallopstable.com. Direct users to https://www.gallop.sg/pages/stable/riding-lessons.html for the currently published lesson details and prices. Do not quote a price unless it is explicitly present in this knowledge file.
faq: Pony rides at Admiralty and Pasir Ris Park take approximately 3 to 5 minutes per round; Downtown East pony rides take approximately 2 to 3 minutes per round. The pony-ride weight limit is 40 kg and the horse-ride weight limit is 75 kg. Walk-in pony rides normally do not require advance booking, but visitors should call before travelling because weather, horse welfare and private bookings can affect availability. Pony feeding is self-paced during its allocated feeding hour. For Admiralty, private-hire drop-offs can use 8 Admiralty Road East and drivers should park at St Helena Road. More FAQs: https://www.gallop.sg/pages/gallopsg/faq.html

promotions: Promotions change over time. Never claim that a promotion is active or provide promotional dates, schedules or prices unless they are explicitly added to this field. Direct visitors to the current promotions page at https://www.gallop.sg/pages/gallopsg/promotion.html or ask them to contact Gallop Stable.
camps: Gallop offers camps and workshops, including stable and pony experiences. Dates, formats, eligibility, availability and prices can change. Direct visitors to https://www.gallop.sg/pages/jackuda/camps-workshops.html and recommend confirming current details with the team.
joining_the_team: Gallop welcomes people who are passionate, energetic, animal-loving and eager to learn. Website roles may include riding instructors, horse grooms (SYCE) and customer service officers. Openings can change, so direct visitors to https://www.gallop.sg/pages/gallopsg/join.html or the relevant venture's Join the Team page, and recommend contacting Gallop Stable to confirm vacancies.
